Inner hierarchy colors (zero layout): BlueOrbs/RedOrbs/GreenOrbs/GoldOrbs/CorruptionShards + MutationTierLabel/MutationXP labels -> Primary Text #E4E9EF via per-node custom_colors/font_color; 32px pixel orb icons untouched (PHASE 6). load_steps 14->16 in ONE patch (mechanism-forced: B2 skips 14->15 because load_steps=15 does not exist in the 04_recovered base that every patch's preimage anchors to; B4 performs the full 14->16). sub id=6 inserted at the canonical position before the first [node] block (after B2's id=5 block -> file order id=5 then id=6, satisfying spec 'id=6 after id=5'). V1 compact tier NOT enabled (default off, S5-gated). No new file paths (roundtrip 3744), no gameplay/collision/input changes, no baseline promotion.
